00:22:21	Toni Wahrstaetter:	My feeling is that no spec change alternative is clearly better than today's implementation. 
Some like the full deferral of state gas refills and it look good initially but comes with the cost of users having to post more gas, opening up larger griefing attacks (e.g. 4337, calls to untrusted contracts), which seems not well enough understood. 
We should check for patterns app devs actually need and implement them natively without them having to rely on gas hacks. This is something for after glam.
